children.value:
import numpy as np
x=np.array([1.,0.,1.]); y=1.
W_h=np.array([[0.2,-0.3],[0.4,0.1],[-0.5,0.2]])
b_h=np.array([-0.4,0.2]); W_o=np.array([-0.3,-0.2]); b_o=0.1
relu=lambda z: np.maximum(0,z)
z_h=x@W_h+b_h; h=relu(z_h); z_o=h@W_o+b_o; y_hat=relu(z_o)
error=y_hat-y; squared_error=(y-y_hat)**2
print('Z hidden:',z_h); print('H hidden:',h); print('Z output:',z_o); print('Prediction:',y_hat); print('Error (y_hat-y):',error); print('Squared error:',squared_error)
